$comment: AUTHORED BASELINE for docs/42-current-decisions.md (#886). Not a regen artifact: regenerated from a scan of the docs, it would classify its own membership and report that as a pass, the same argument that keeps payload-manifest.json and token-contract.json out of regen.ts. A 'Decided (date, #issue): title' heading anywhere in docs/ that has no row here fails lint-decisions-index.ts's converse arm. Append with `npx tsx packages/engine/lint-decisions-index.ts --accept`, which appends only and refuses to rewrite an existing row — a superseding decision is a hand edit, same posture as lint-shape-index.ts.
